title: Algebra and Functions Unit Test
subject: math
unitTitle: Algebraic manipulation and graphs of functions

points.text: Expands to x^2 - 5x + 3x - 15 with all four products correct

items.prompt: Make t the subject of the formula v = u + at.

points.text: Subtracts u from both sides: v - u = at
Divides by a: t = (v - u) / a

items.prompt: Sketch the graph of y = x^2 - 2x - 3, marking both x-intercepts and the turning point.

points.text: Factorises or solves to give intercepts at x = 3 and x = -1
Turning point at (1, -4) marked on an upward parabola

items.prompt: Explain how the roots of x^2 - 2x - 3 = 0 can be read from the graph of y = x^2 - 2x - 3.

points.text: States the roots are the x-values where the graph cuts the x-axis (y = 0)
Reads the roots as x = 3 and x = -1

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Manipulation is accurate and each step is justified or clearly sequenced.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Method is sound but with slips that the working makes visible.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Steps are disconnected or unjustified; the method cannot be followed.
